parent_contract.rule: Continue expansion if any route can materially add independent canonical events, PIT-valid coverage, pre-event temporal depth, economically justified breadth, distributional/cross-venue information, or provenance/reproducibility. Stop only if all remaining routes are immaterial, fail quality gates, are economically unjustified, or are infeasible.

route_tests.continue_if: W4-B contains any UNRESOLVED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH groups and the pre-outcome source registry contains primary corporate/event-truth authorities.
route_tests.required_new_freeze: Separate W4-C truth-extension protocol; W4-B official truth remains immutable.

route_tests.continue_if: Polymarket canonical census N is positive while polymarket_backtestable_claim_authorized is false.
route_tests.required_new_freeze: Venue-specific PIT history/snapshot protocol before any linked-asset outcome reveal.

route_tests.continue_if: ForecastEx canonical census N is positive while forecastex_backtestable_claim_authorized is false.
The frozen family-expansion registry contains any P0 candidate still gated for a separate family census.
route_tests.required_new_freeze: Separate family dictionary and census; never edit W4-BER-v1.0 in place.

route_tests.continue_if: POLYMARKET_V1_ARCHIVE remains at a P0 archive-access/reconciliation gate in the frozen data-source registry.
route_tests.required_new_freeze: Identifier reconciliation and archive provenance protocol; official APIs remain semantic authority.

route_tests.continue_if: Any prediction_market_primary source remains at P1_DATA_ACCESS_GATE with non-NONE independent-N or breadth gain.
route_tests.required_new_freeze: Per-venue data-access/PIT protocol before population inclusion.

route_tests.continue_if: A robustness-only venue remains unexecuted with HIGH external-validity/depth/breadth gain.
route_tests.required_new_freeze: Separate robustness protocol; never pool with primary real-money N without authorization.

decision_rule.CONTINUE_EXPANSION_NOT_SATURATED: At least one route_test is open.
decision_rule.STOP_SATURATED: All route_tests are closed or fail materiality/PIT/provenance/economic-feasibility requirements.

immutable_W4B.rule: W4-C extensions may add separately versioned evidence but must never rewrite the W4-B attrition or official-truth result.
